cards.ex: I'm getting tired; let's call it a day and finish up tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Men charchayapman; keling, bugungi ishni tugatamiz va ertaga yakunlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Ishni shu bilan tugatishni, kunni yakunlashni aytish.

cards.ex: It was hard at first, but I'm starting to get the hang of this new software.
cards.exUz: Dastlab qiyin edi, lekin men bu yangi dasturiy ta'minotni o'rganishni boshladim.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir uslubini, qanday qilishni o'rganib olish.

cards.ex: He's determined to climb the ladder and become a CEO one day.
cards.exUz: U martaba pillapoyalaridan ko'tarilib, bir kun bosh direktor bo'lishga qaror qilgan.
cards.uzDef: Ish joyida yuqori lavozimlarga erishish, martaba pillapoyalaridan ko'tarilish.

cards.ex: I work best under pressure; it helps me focus.
cards.exUz: Men bosim ostida yaxshiroq ishlayman; bu menga diqqatni jamlashga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p talablar, stress yoki vaqt cheklovlari ostida bo'lish.

cards.ex: We're looking for someone who's a real team player and can communicate well.
cards.exUz: Biz haqiqiy jamoa a'zosi bo'lgan va yaxshi muloqot qila oladigan odamni qidirmoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Jamoa bilan yaxshi ishlaydigan, boshqalar bilan hamkorlik qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: Alright, everyone, let's get down to business and discuss the project budget.
cards.exUz: Xo'sh, hammangiz, keling, ishga kirishamiz va loyiha byudjetini muhokama qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy mavzuga o'tish, ishni boshlash.

cards.ex: I had to burn the midnight oil to finish the report on time.
cards.exUz: Hisobotni o'z vaqtida tugatish uchun men kechgacha ishlashim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Kechgacha, ko'p vaqt davomida qattiq ishlash.

cards.ex: We need to think outside the box to find a solution to this problem.
cards.exUz: Bu muammoni hal qilish uchun biz standartdan tashqari o'ylashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi, ijodiy va noodatiy g'oyalarni o'ylash.

cards.ex: With the deadline looming, everyone's working overtime.
cards.exUz: Muddat yaqinlashgach, hamma qo'shimcha vaqt ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Muddat juda yaqinlashib qolgan, vaqt tugashiga oz qolgan.

cards.ex: She has a clear career path planned out for the next five years.
cards.exUz: U keyingi besh yilga mo'ljallangan aniq kasbiy yo'lga ega.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishining ish hayoti davomida qilgan ishlari va lavozimlari.

cards.ex: It took him months, but he finally landed a job in marketing.
cards.exUz: Unga bir necha oy kerak bo'ldi, lekin u nihoyat marketing bo'yicha ishga joylashdi.
cards.uzDef: Ish topmoq, ishga qabul qilinmoq.

cards.ex: I'm tired of the nine-to-five; I need something more flexible.
cards.exUz: Men 8 dan 5 gacha bo'lgan ishdan charchadim; menga moslashuvchanroq narsa kerak.
cards.uzDef: Odatda ertalab soat 9 dan kech soat 5 gacha bo'lgan normal ish vaqti.

cards.ex: She always goes the extra mile for her clients.
cards.exUz: U har doim o'z mijozlari uchun qo'shimcha harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy talablardan tashqari ko'proq harakat qilish, imkoniyatdan tashqari harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I like employees who take the initiative and don't wait to be told what to do.
cards.exUz: Men tashabbus ko'rsatadigan va nima qilishni aytishlarini kutmaydigan xodimlarni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: O'z-o'zidan biror ishni boshlash, ko'rsatma kutmasdan harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I had to call in sick today because I woke up with a fever.
cards.exUz: Bugun men isitmam bilan uyg'onganligim sababli kasalman deb qo'ng'iroq qilishim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Kasal bo'lganligi sababli ishga kelmasligini xabar qilish.

cards.ex: Due to the economic downturn, many employees were laid off.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiy pasayish tufayli ko'plab xodimlar ishdan bo'shatildi.
cards.uzDef: Ishdan qisqartirilgan, kompaniya tomonidan ishdan bo'shatilgan.

cards.ex: His strong work ethic and dedication make him a valuable asset.
cards.exUz: Uning kuchli ish axloqi va sadoqati uni qimmatli aktivga aylantiradi.
cards.uzDef: Ishga bo'lgan qadriyatlar, printsip va munosabatlar to'plami.

cards.ex: She worked really hard and finally got a promotion to senior manager.
cards.exUz: U juda ko'p ishladi va nihoyat katta menejer lavozimiga ko'tarildi.
cards.uzDef: Ish joyida yuqori lavozimga erishish.

cards.ex: Let's make sure we're all on the same page before we start the project.
cards.exUz: Loyiha boshlashdan oldin, hammamiz bir xil fikrda ekanligimizga ishonch hosil qilaylik.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil tushunchaga ega bo'lish, bir xil fikrga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The company cut corners to save money, which affected the product quality.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya pulni tejash uchun xarajatlarni qisqartirdi, bu esa mahsulot sifatiga ta'sir qildi.
cards.uzDef: Arzonroq va tezroq usulni tanlash, sifatni qurbon qilish.

cards.ex: We need a go-getter on this team to drive sales.
cards.exUz: Sotuvni rivojlantirish uchun bizga ushbu jamoada ishchan odam kerak.
cards.uzDef: Faol, g'ayratli va muvaffaqiyatga intiluvchan odam.

cards.ex: I have a full plate right now, so I can't take on any new projects.
cards.exUz: Hozirda juda ko'p ishim bor, shuning uchun men yangi loyihalarni qabul qila olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p vazifalar va mas'uliyatlar borligi.

cards.ex: It's important to maintain a good work-life balance to avoid burnout.
cards.exUz: Charchoqni oldini olish uchun yaxshi ish va hayot muvozanatini saqlash muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Ish va shaxsiy hayot o'rtasidagi sog'lom muvozanat.

cards.ex: The company has a strict dress code: suits for men and formal attire for women.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning qattiq kiyim kodi bor: erkaklar uchun kostyumlar va ayollar uchun rasmiy kiyimlar.
cards.uzDef: Ish joyida qanday kiyim kiyish kerakligi haqidagi qoidalar to'plami.

cards.ex: She joined the team last week and hit the ground running.
cards.exUz: U o'tgan hafta jamoaga qo'shildi va darhol ishga tushdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ish yoki vazifani darhol va samarali boshlash.

cards.ex: Nine times out of ten, a good resume will get you an interview.
cards.exUz: Ko'pincha, yaxshi rezyume sizni suhbatga olib keladi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'pincha, deyarli har doim shunday bo'ladi.

cards.ex: Let's pencil in a meeting for next week, but I'll confirm the time later.
cards.exUz: Keling, kelgusi hafta uchun uchrashuvni vaqtincha rejalashtiramiz, lekin men vaqtni keyinroq tasdiqlayman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani rejalashtirmoq, ammo aniq emas, vaqtincha yozib qo'ymoq.

cards.ex: One of the perks of the job is free gym membership.
cards.exUz: Ishning imtiyozlaridan biri - bepul sport zaliga a'zolik.
cards.uzDef: Ish bilan bog'liq qo'shimcha foydali narsalar, bonuslar.

cards.ex: We had to put that project on the back burner because we ran out of funds.
cards.exUz: Biz bu loyihani kechroqqa qoldirishga majbur bo'ldik, chunki mablag'imiz tugadi.
cards.uzDef: Hozirda muhim bo'lmagan, keyinroq ko'rib chiqiladigan loyiha yoki ish.

cards.ex: The new project is up for grabs; who wants to lead it?
cards.exUz: Yangi loyiha hamma uchun ochiq; uni kim boshqarmoqchi?
cards.uzDef: Hali hech kimga tegishli bo'lmagan, hamma olishi mumkin bo'lgan narsa.
